description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling JSONL files with embedded newlines, replacing models within JSONL content, and determining metadata variable names based on function names. It also defines an in-memory file class for handling file-like objects.

classes.name: InMemoryFile
classes.description: A subclass of io.BytesIO that adds filename and content_type attributes for in-memory file handling.

methods.name: parse_jsonl_with_embedded_newlines
methods.description: Parses JSONL content with embedded newlines in string values, returning a list of JSON objects.

methods.name: should_replace_model_in_jsonl
methods.description: Determines if the model name should be replaced in a JSONL file based on its purpose.

methods.name: replace_model_in_jsonl
methods.description: Replaces the model name in JSON objects within a JSONL file content, handling various input types.

methods.name: _get_router_metadata_variable_name
methods.description: Returns the appropriate metadata variable name based on the function name, distinguishing certain endpoints.
